subject: Reject a +CONTINUE reply to PSYNC when there is no cached primary (#5126)
reason: The fix guards against a primary that violates the replication protocol by replying +CONTINUE to a PSYNC ? -1 (full-resync) request from a replica with no cached primary. A conformant Valkey primary never does this (primaryTryPartialResynchronization always forces a full resync when the requested replid is '?'; the dual-channel +CONTINUE case is handled before the new guard), so the only way to produce the triggering reply is a non-conformant peer, which is why the upstream test needs a bespoke fake_primary.tcl.
